ability.name: The Carrion Dirge
ability.effect: Subtract 3 from each target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

ability.name: Rustfang
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy **^^Hero^^** in combat with this unit to be the target.

ability.name: The Witherstave
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **^^Strike-last^^** for the rest of the turn.
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
